flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: crud/beans/SystemConstant (suspension code list), agencies/mha/download/{MhaNricDownloadHelper,MhaNricRecordValidator} (TS-NRO for invalid address), datahiveuenfin/DataHiveUenFinService (placeholder createWorkItem*), toppan/upload/ToppanUploadHelper (letter_address). ocmsadminapi: furnish/stafffurnish/StaffFurnishService (choosing the letter address). ocmsadminui: Work Items menu without a page. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Story status: User Story Removed, so it is not claimed. There is no detection of registered vs furnished difference, no dedicated suspension code for it, and no work item (only a placeholder log). Similar code: automatic TS-NRO for an invalid MHA address and the letter address choice in staff furnish; both are logged as orphans 'Removed tapi mirip'. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.

steps.step: OCMS determines that the registered address differs from the address furnished by the vehicle owner/hirer
steps.detail: Same fact as OCMS41.61 step 2: no comparison of the mha_reg row with furnished_mail exists in the six repos. The mha_reg write paths do not read furnished_mail, and the only equals on postal code is the '000000' invalid address check (MhaNricRecordValidator.java:193).

steps.step: The notice is temporarily suspended under a specific suspension code
steps.detail: The SuspensionReason list (NRO, ACR, SYS, HST, PAM, UNC, OLD, PDP, MID, DIP, APP, CAN, etc.) has no code for a registered vs furnished address difference (SystemConstant.java:31-64). TS-NRO is applied automatically for an invalid MHA address (invalid tag, street NA, postal 000000, address change date in the future; MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:1210), but that is a different trigger and is logged as an orphan.

steps.step: A work item is created holding the notice details and both address sets (registered and furnished)
steps.detail: The only work item creation is a placeholder that writes a log line and persists nothing (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2906-2924, :3037-3046; comment 'Work item creation is not ready yet'). There is no ocms_work_item entity or repository to store the notice and two addresses.

steps.step: The work item is routed to the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: The staff UI only has a Work Items menu entry with an HST child (LinkData.tsx:170-176) and a /work-item path constant (Meta/WorkItem.ts:1-12). No route or page displays work items, and ocmsadminapi has no API to fetch them.

steps.step: The OIC follows up and decides which address the reminder is sent to
steps.detail: There is no follow-up screen driven by a work item. Only the normal staff furnish path exists: furnished_mail can be marked as the letter address and the flag on other rows is reset (StaffFurnishService.java:1005-1008), and the letter uses the row with letter_address=Y (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2199). The choice of letter address exists technically, but without a mismatch trigger or work item. Removed story: Sebagian.
